data_product_description: The NHS Wales Dentistry dashboard shows general and orthodontic activity across all contracts. It helps commissioners and providers review trends, compare areas and access up to 7 years of historical data.
data_product_overview:
## Data Product Overview
There is a need for dental commissioners and providers to monitor the activity of dental providers both nationally and within a specific area. This helps make sure that services are commissioned effectively to maximise the benefit to patients.

To enable this, several dashboards are available within the eDEN system to allow users to access a range of dental data, including detailed information extracted from the FP17.

This dashboard provides information on general and orthodontic dental activity for all contracts nationally. Data is available at a number of different organisational levels, including national, ICB, contract and performer level within the dashboard.

Data can be accessed for the current financial year, with historical data available for the previous 7 full financial years.

Several download tabs are also available within the dashboard to allow users to easily extract the information from the system.
